summary: Change the schedule's day or period and see a calendar's appointments instead of the ones assigned to you.

steps.title: Menu → My Workspace
steps.details: The doctor's view: their schedule and the clinical panel of the patient they're seeing.

steps.title: Day or period
steps.details: Today, tomorrow, this week, the next 7 days, this month… or a day or period on the calendar.

steps.title: Choose the day or the period
steps.details: A day shows its schedule; a period groups the appointments by day. Days other than today are read-only for the clinical session.

steps.title: Assigned to me
steps.details: Only the appointments where you're the doctor.

steps.title: My calendars
steps.details: The appointments of a room you have access to, whether yours or another doctor's.

steps.title: Choose the calendar
steps.details: The room or calendar whose appointments you want to see.
